name: Wake the Dead
source:
21 years ago, a plague of zombies brought the world to ruin. Now you and your companions must battle for survival against enemies both alive and dead.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Wake_the_Dead]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
21年前，一场僵尸瘟疫让世界陷入毁灭。现在你和你的同伴必须与生死存亡的敌人战斗以求生存。

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Wake_the_Dead]Choices Wikia[/url]]
